question: Ankita Raina is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tennis.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• 
 **Ankita Ravinderkrishan Raina **is a **tennis player **from India who was born on** January 11, 1993.**
 
 
• 
 She has consistently been ranked **first **in India in both **singles **and **doubles **since **2013**.
 
 
• 
 Raina has won** 11 singles championships** and **23 doubles titles **on the **ITF Circuit **in addition to one **WTA Tour title **and one title at **WTA 125 events **(all in doubles).
 
 
• 
 She became just the **fifth Indian player **to do so in **April 2018** as she made her debut appearance in the **top 200 singles rankings**.
 
 
• 
 At the **2016 **South Asian Games, Raina also won **gold **in the **women's singles **and **mixed-doubles competitions.**
 
 
• 
 At the **2018 **Asian Games, she took home a **bronze **in the **singles competition**.
 
 
• 
 One of just two women from India who has **competed **at the **WTA level **is Raina. 
 
 
• **Lalita Raina** and **Ravinder Kishen Raina** were Raina's **parents **when she was born in the Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• She was **raised **in **Ahmedabad **where she was born and raised before **relocating **to **Pune**, Maharashtra, at the age of **14.**
 
• The choice to relocate was predicated on a **strong showing **at the **Asians 14 **and under masters competition in **Melbourne**, where she finished **second**, and the fact that **Pune **has better **infrastructure **for developing **young tennis talent.**
 
• Raina is fluent in** Gujarati, English, Hindi, **and **Kashmiri.**
 
• Raina has represented **Gujarat**, the state where she is from, at **national events.**
